c01_star_explained_same_position.note: star carried on the same GT position as a covering literal deletion

c02_star_explained_large_deletion.note: supporting deletion exceeds the 50-base applied-allele cap; footprint still bounded

c03_star_orphan_single.note: no covering deletion; span bounded by flanking bases called present on every copy

c04_star_orphan_cluster.note: consecutive orphan stars, star allele first; one shared bounded envelope

c05_star_multiallelic_same_record.note: copy 0 carries the record's own 7 bp deletion; copy 1's star is bounded by flanks

c06_star_filtered_support.note: filtered supporting call is not a complete carried call; star remains unexplained

c07_overlapping_same_copies_conflict.note: both copies carry both overlapping edits; overlap cannot be applied

c08a_overlapping_split_copies_starred.note: starred split copies with opposite GT orders; resolution must pair deletion and star

c08b_overlapping_split_copies_contradict.note: overlapping records without star encoding contradict; conflict gap preserved

c09_missing_call.note: missing call masks the record on every declared copy

c10_partial_missing_call.note: partially missing call masks the record on every declared copy

c11_phase_block_boundary.note: phase-set boundary at 1116; windows touching only one set stay evaluable

c12_supported_indel_paths.note: 2 bp insertion retains boundary/offset path; SNV on the other copy

c13_complex_allele_bounded.note: complex allele: bounded footprint; not applicable as an edit

c14_star_orphan_unbounded.note: no anchors and no covering deletion: whole-contig exclusion names the missing record

x01_xy_region_specific_ploidy.note: diploid and haploid intervals on one contig, declared explicitly

x02_xy_diploid_call_in_haploid_region.note: diploid syntax in a declared haploid interval stays unsupported

x03_xy_undeclared_ploidy.note: no ploidy intervals: contig name must not imply copies

x04_xy_zero_copies.note: zero declared copies: no materialization, explicit exclusion

x05_xy_haploid_star_explained.note: haploid carrier: star explained by the same copy's covering deletion

x06_xy_par_star_explained.note: star carried on copy 0, explained by the same copy's deletion in a diploid interval
